title: Birch bark
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of birch bark: chalk-white papery bark with horizontal lenticels, chevron branch scars, dark fissured patches and peeling strips. Use on birch trunks and logs.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python bark_birch.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: lenticels
parameters.meaning: Density of the horizontal lenticel dashes.

parameters.name: lenticel_length
parameters.meaning: Average lenticel length in texture units.

parameters.name: branch_scars
parameters.meaning: Dark chevron branch scars on the tile.

parameters.name: peeling
parameters.meaning: Strips of outer bark peeled off, showing the inner bark.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Paper birch: chalk-white bark with dark lenticels and a few scars.

presets.name: silver_aged
presets.description: Older silver birch with large black fissured patches.

presets.name: river_birch
presets.description: Salmon-tan river birch with heavy curling peel.

presets.name: young_smooth
presets.description: Young smooth birch with fine, sparse lenticels and no scars.

limits: Marks are placed at random in texture space; real birch bark changes along the trunk, which a single tile cannot show. Peeling strips are flat bands with a raised lip, not separate geometry. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate.
technique_references: V-shaped stamp profile for branch scars
Anisotropic fractional Brownian motion thresholded for dark patches
Ragged ellipse stamps for peeled strips
